description:
About Metron 

 Metron is an employee-owned company dedicated to delivering innovative solutions for the most challenging national security problems. For over 40 years, our principled approach to problem-solving has yielded creative solutions at the intersection of advanced mathematics, computer science, physics, and engineering. Our people are leaders in their technical fields and are passionate about solving challenging problems. We look for individuals who share this same passion and can apply their experience in real-world settings.   

  

 
 
 
 Metron is seeking a mid-level Software Engineer to help design, build, and mature software systems that support simulation, optimization, and decision support for mission-focused applications.

 This role is best suited for an engineer who is comfortable working across the software stack and who can contribute to both technical implementation and product maturation. You will help transform prototypes and advanced technical concepts into reliable, maintainable software used in operational and decision-support settings.

 Responsibilities

 In this role, you will be expected to:

 
 Build and maintain production-quality software that supports mission-oriented analysis, simulation, and decision support

 Help translate technically sophisticated algorithms, models, and research prototypes into usable software applications

 Improve software quality through thoughtful design, code readability, testing, documentation, and maintainable engineering practices

 Build responsive, usable, and intuitive frontends that present complex data and workflows clearly to users

 Contribute across the full development lifecycle, including concept exploration, prototyping, implementation, testing, demonstration, deployment, and sustainment

 Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams to understand user needs and deliver practical, high-impact solutions

 
 Required Qualifications   

 
 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, mathematics, physics, applied mathematics, engineering, or a related technical field

 At least 2 years of professional software development experience

 Strong foundation in object-oriented design and software development, with experience in Java, C++, Rust, or other comparable programming languages

 Experience creating backend software and/or APIs in collaborative production or prototype environments

 Strong engineering fundamentals, sound technical judgment, and the ability to collaborate effectively with researchers, engineers, and end users

 U.S. CITIZENSHIP REQUIRED ; successful candidates will be subject to a security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information

 






 Desired Qualifications 

 
 
 
 
 Active SECRET security clearance

 Experience writing high-performance, multi-threaded (parallel/concurrent) software

 Experience developing high-quality software in an environment where readability, maintainability, testing, and disciplined engineering practices are valued

 Experience in defense, national security, or other mission-driven environments

 Experience with TypeScript and React or other modern frontend development frameworks

 Experience with 3D, geospatial, or high-performance visualization technologies such as WebGL or OpenGL

 Experience with data-intensive or distributed systems, including databases, messaging systems, and asynchronous processing

 Familiarity with AI/ML-enabled applications, including LLM-integrated systems

 Experience with cloud and containerized deployment environments such as AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines

 
 Position Location:   Reston, VA 

 *The selected individual(s) will be required to work from the Reston, VA office. 

 Perks and Benefits 

 
 Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance   

 Accompanying FSA and HSA options   

 Additional Voluntary Benefits    

 Paid Time Off    

 9 Observed Holidays and 2 Floating Holidays    

 Paid Parental Leave    

 Tuition Reimbursement   

 Relocation Assistance 

 Professional Development Reimbursement   

 Annual Salary Reviews    

 Profit Sharing    

 401(k) Traditional and Roth Options    

 Gym and Fitness Reimbursement    

 Employee Assistance Program    

 Employee Referral Program   

 





  

 Metron is an Equal  Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer. It is the policy of the company to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religious, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information.
